description: This file defines a utility namespace 'AgentWorkspace' for managing agent workspace directories, including handling templates, checking workspace status, and initializing default files. It provides methods for resolving workspace URLs, creating directories and default files, and inspecting or bootstrapping the workspace environment.

classes.name: BootstrapSafety
classes.description: A structure representing the safety status of the workspace, indicating whether it is safe or blocked due to some reason.

methods.name: displayPath
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly string representing the given URL's path, replacing the home directory with '~' when applicable.

methods.name: resolveWorkspaceURL
methods.description: Resolves a workspace URL from a user input string, expanding tilde and defaulting if input is nil or empty.

methods.name: agentsURL
methods.description: Constructs the URL for the agents file within the workspace.

methods.name: workspaceEntries
methods.description: Returns the list of entries (excluding ignored entries) within the workspace directory.

methods.name: isWorkspaceEmpty
methods.description: Checks whether the workspace directory exists and is empty.

methods.name: isTemplateOnlyWorkspace
methods.description: Determines if the workspace contains only template files, i.e., no additional files.

methods.name: bootstrapSafety
methods.description: Evaluates whether the workspace is safe to bootstrap, checking for existing files and directory state.

methods.name: bootstrap
methods.description: Initializes the workspace by creating necessary files and directories, writing default templates where needed.

methods.name: needsBootstrap
methods.description: Checks whether the workspace needs bootstrap initialization, based on existence and contents.

methods.name: hasIdentity
methods.description: Checks if the IDENTITY.md file exists and contains non-empty identity information.

methods.name: identityLinesHaveValues
methods.description: Helper function to verify if IDENTITY.md content has any non-empty identity fields.

methods.name: defaultTemplate
methods.description: Provides the default content for AGENTS.md, the agent workspace descriptor.

methods.name: defaultSoulTemplate
methods.description: Provides the default content for SOUL.md, describing the agent's persona and boundaries.

methods.name: defaultIdentityTemplate
methods.description: Provides the default content for IDENTITY.md, describing the agent's identity.

methods.name: defaultUserTemplate
methods.description: Provides the default content for USER.md, describing user profile information.

methods.name: defaultBootstrapTemplate
methods.description: Provides the default content for BOOTSTRAP.md, which guides first-time setup.

methods.name: loadTemplate
methods.description: Attempts to load a template file from various sources, falling back to default content.

methods.name: templateURLs
methods.description: Returns array of URLs where templates might be located.

methods.name: devTemplateURL
methods.description: Constructs a URL pointing to a development template location within the repo.

methods.name: stripFrontMatter
methods.description: Removes front-matter metadata from a markdown template if present.
